package smtp // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/smtp"

const DefaultTimeout = 15 * time.Second

var ErrDisabled = errors.New("mail is not configured")

var ErrInvalidMessage = errors.New("smtp: invalid message")

func ParseFrom(value string) (string, error)

type Config struct {
	Host     string
	Port     int
	Username string
	Password string

	From string

	Mode TLSMode

	Timeout time.Duration

	RootCAs *x509.CertPool
}

type Disabled struct{}

func (Disabled) Enabled() bool

func (Disabled) Send(context.Context, Message) error

type Message struct {
	To      string
	Subject string
	Body    string
}

type SMTP struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

func New(cfg Config) (*SMTP, error)

func (s *SMTP) Enabled() bool

func (s *SMTP) Send(ctx context.Context, msg Message) (err error)

type Sender interface {
	Enabled() bool
	Send(ctx context.Context, msg Message) error
}

type TLSMode string

const (
	TLSStartTLS TLSMode = "starttls"

	TLSImplicit TLSMode = "implicit"

	TLSNone TLSMode = "none"
)

func ParseTLSMode(value string) (TLSMode, error)
